title: OpenFOAM case generation for counterflow diffusion flames

task_sources.name: CFDLLMBench FoamBench Basic counterFlowFlame2D cases and evaluation scripts, BSD-3-Clause

metric.description: Physical success rate over 9 simulation cases: execution and complete finite U/p/T fields must pass, then their spatially matched mean NMSE must be < 0.1. Missing or failed cases count as zero; denominator 9, higher is better. The reported author baseline predates the field/spatial corrections and proposed tutorial contract; it is retained as a historical report, not independently reproduced under the revised rules. The tutorial contract awaits author confirmation before formal scoring.

baseline.name: Foam-Agent with gpt-6-luna, max_loop=15, OpenFOAM v10
